content.text: Screening the library with band-gap predictions, then measuring the most promising compositions.

input.verdict: MEGNet HSE gaps: V2O5 2.83 eV (near/above 2.72 eV photon energy), Cu2O 1.56 eV. Weak support: the model results don't speak to BiVO4 directly (ID lookup failed). Measuring 143 (Bi0.36 Cu0.21 V0.43) because it sits near the BiVO4 Bi:V≈1 line, a known visible-light photoanode, and has the least Cu. It is the region's prior-knowledge anchor.

input.verdict: MEGNet HSE gives CuO 0.32 eV, a narrow-gap absorber that would likely act as a recombination/dark phase. That argues against the Cu-rich corner (Cu>0.7). Measuring 24 (Cu≈V, Bi 0.09) to test the copper-vanadate (Cu2V2O7-type, ~2 eV gap) photoanode region instead. This is a contrast point against the BiVO4-side result.

content.text:
I've submitted the episode, with **index 24 (Bi 0.088, Cu 0.466, V 0.446)** as the best composition at a photocurrent of **49.6 µA**. I can't tell how close that is to the library's best, because only 3 of the 188 compositions were measured.

The budget allowed 3 merit measurements:

| Index | Bi / Cu / V | Photocurrent | Why I measured it |
|---|---|---|---|
| 143 | 0.36 / 0.21 / 0.43 | 22.9 µA | Closest to BiVO₄, a known visible-light photoanode |
| 24 | 0.09 / 0.47 / 0.45 | **49.6 µA** | Copper vanadate (Cu₂V₂O₇-type) region |
| 119 | 0.08 / 0.50 / 0.42 | 43.0 µA | Next to 24, a bit more Cu |

- **The copper vanadate region did best.** Both points there beat the BiVO₄-side point by about a factor of two. 24 and 119 are close in composition and gave similar results, which suggests a real effect rather than one lucky film.
- **I didn't measure the Cu-rich corner (Cu above 0.7).** The band-gap model gives CuO only 0.32 eV, so those films probably lose most of their charge carriers before they produce current. That is a model prediction, not a measurement.
- **The model checks had little influence on which points I measured.** The full phase list was too large to return, so I looked up simple oxides by guessed Materials Project IDs: CuO 0.32 eV, Cu₂O 1.56 eV, Bi₂O₃ 2.34 eV, V₂O₅ 2.83 eV. The lookup for BiVO₄ failed. I didn't run the stability model, and the choices mostly came from prior knowledge of these materials.
- **I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements.** I don't know which crystal phases actually formed in the measured films.
- **I didn't take the model's suggestion for the last measurement.** After two measurements, the Gaussian-process model suggested index 126 (Bi 0.17, Cu 0.40, V 0.42). I measured 119, next to the best point, instead. So the area around 126 and the vanadium-rich side of the copper vanadate region are still unmeasured.
